MADHAVI UPPALURU 
Business Analyst Lead/Project Manager — Payments Domain 
Hyderabad, India  |  +91 9248768727 |  madhu.uppaluru12@gmail.com 
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Business Analyst Lead with 15 years of experience in the financial services and payments industry, transitioning deep cash 
application and accounts receivable expertise into payment systems business analysis. Skilled in requirements elicitation 
for cross-border payment processing, SWIFT MT-to-MX (ISO 20022) migration, SEPA integration, and payment 
orchestration. Strong background in cash applications, ACH, wire transfers, cheque clearing, and reconciliation, combined 
with US capital market and securities transaction processing. Experienced in documenting end-to-end payment flows, 
writing functional specifications, and translating regulatory mandates into implementable system requirements. Hands-on 
with Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, BPMN 2.0, Postman, and SQL. 
CORE COMPETENCIES 
Payment Rails & Schemes:  SWIFT MT/MX, ISO 20022, SEPA (SCT/SDD), CHAPS, ACH, BACS, NEFT, RTGS, GPP, Cross-
Border & Correspondent Banking, Clearing & Settlement 
Message Formats:  MT103, MT202, pacs.008, pacs.003, pain.001, pain.008, camt.053, camt.054 
Payments Functions:  Payment Orchestration, STP (Straight-Through Processing), Repair Queues, Exception Handling, 
Return/Recall Processing, Cutoff Management, Reconciliation 
Risk & Compliance:  Sanctions Screening (OFAC / EU lists), AML Transaction Monitoring, Payment Gateway Integration 
Business Analysis:  Requirements Elicitation, BRD, FRD, Functional Specifications, Use Cases, User Stories, Acceptance 
Criteria, Gap Analysis, AS-IS / TO-BE Modeling, Process Mapping, Wireframing / Prototyping, Stakeholder Management 
Data & Testing:  ETL, Data Migration, SQL Server, API Testing (Postman / REST Client), SIT, UAT, Regression, Integration & 
UI Testing 
Tools:  Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Postman, BPMN 2.0, UML, Salesforce, Zoho 
Methodologies:  Agile / Scrum, Waterfall, SDLC, Release Management, Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement 
WORK EXPERIENCE 
Business Analyst Lead/ Project Manager — Payments Domain Aug 2010 – Present 
Unisys India Pvt. Ltd. (merged with CompuGain) 
• Led business analysis for a large-scale cross-border payments transformation programme, defining requirements for 
SWIFT MT-to-MX (ISO 20022) message migration across correspondent banking, trade finance, and treasury payment 
flows. 
• Authored detailed functional specifications for SEPA Credit Transfer (SCT) and SEPA Direct Debit (SDD) integration, 
covering pacs.008, pacs.003, pain.001, pain.008, and camt.053/054 message formats and reconciliation workflows. 
• Defined end-to-end requirements for CHAPS real-time gross settlement interfaces and ACH batch clearing 
integrations, including cutoff time management, exception handling, and return / recall processing. 
• Elicited and documented payment gateway integration requirements covering routing logic, sanctions screening 
(OFAC / EU lists), and AML transaction-monitoring engine interfaces. 
• Mapped current-state payment processing workflows using BPMN 2.0 and designed future-state orchestration flows 
for straight-through processing (STP), repair queues, and manual intervention routing, facilitating sprint planning and 
backlog refinement. 
KEY PROJECTS 
• Radian — Leading provider of mortgage insurance, risk management, and real estate technology solutions. Helps 
financial institutions manage credit risk and supports sustainable homeownership through data-driven analytics and 
innovative financial services. 
• Gategourmet —It is a global leader in airline catering and onboard hospitality services, providing meals, provisioning, 
and logistics solutions for airlines worldwide. It is the flagship catering brand of gategroup and operates one of the 
aviation industry's largest catering networks, serving airlines across multiple continents. 
• Gridpoint — Energy Management System — Drove complex, multi-vendor enterprise programmes end-to-end, 
aligning scope, delivery timelines, and quality standards while establishing clear ownership and execution 
accountability. 
• Neustar — Enterprise Website Management System — Converted business objectives into wireframes, mock flows, 
user stories, and FRDs with acceptance criteria, enabling clear, build-ready functional specifications. 
• Neustar — Web Infrastructure — Owned end-to-end process mapping and gap tracking in Jira, ensuring all design 
changes, prototype gaps, and decisions were traceable, assigned, and governed. 
• Neustar — Registry Service — Executed System, Regression, Functional, Integration, and UI testing, embedding 
quality, stability, and reliability into every release. 
• Ameriprise Financial — Long View Trading System — Validated APIs using Postman and REST Client, with hands-on 
exposure to exploratory, usability, installation, security, and compatibility testing across diverse environments. 
• American Express — Secure Message Center — Delivered CRM capabilities across Salesforce (case workflows) and 
Zoho, coordinating complex data migrations from multiple source systems for mortgage billing and stakeholder 
operations.
